mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.status <> 'DELETED' )

SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.project_id, t.created_by, t.thread_key, t.title, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM agent_threads t JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE t.thread_key = #{threadKey} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.created_by = #{userId}

SELECT t.id, t.workspace_id, t.project_id, t.created_by, t.thread_key, t.title, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM agent_threads t JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.created_by = #{userId} ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC, t.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_threads(workspace_id, project_id, created_by, thread_key, title) VALUES(#{workspaceId}, #{projectId}, #{createdBy}, #{threadKey}, #{title})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_threads SET title = #{title}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_runs WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND status = 'RUNNING' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_messages(thread_id, client_message_id, role, content, status, attachments) VALUES(#{threadId}, #{clientMessageId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, CAST(#{attachments} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_messages SET content = #{content}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT attachments::text FROM agent_messages WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_messages SET attachments = CAST(#{attachments} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT client_message_id FROM agent_messages WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.thread_id, m.client_message_id, m.role, m.content, m.status, m.attachments::text AS attachments, m.created_at FROM agent_messages m JOIN agent_threads t ON t.id = m.thread_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.thread_id = #{threadId} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY m.created_at, m.id

SELECT m.id, m.thread_id, m.client_message_id, m.role, m.content, m.status, m.attachments::text AS attachments, m.created_at FROM agent_messages m JOIN agent_threads t ON t.id = m.thread_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.thread_id = #{threadId} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND m.role = 'USER' ORDER BY m.created_at, m.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runs(run_key, thread_id, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, status) VALUES(#{runKey}, #{threadId}, #{userMessageId}, #{assistantMessageId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.run_key, r.thread_id, r.user_message_id, r.assistant_message_id, r.status, r.error_message, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.created_at FROM agent_runs r JOIN agent_threads t ON t.id = r.thread_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE r.run_key = #{runKey} AND t.project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT id, run_key, thread_id, user_message_id, assistant_message_id, status, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at FROM agent_runs WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY created_at

SELECT id, workspace_id, project_id, user_id, run_id, run_key, model_name, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, compressed_context_tokens, context_message_count FROM agent_token_usage WHERE run_key = #{runKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runs SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE finished_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run_events(run_id, event_type, payload) VALUES(#{runId}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO agent_token_usage( workspace_id, project_id, user_id, run_id, run_key, model_name, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, compressed_context_tokens, context_message_count ) VALUES( #{workspaceId}, #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{runId}, #{runKey}, #{modelName}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{compressedContextTokens}, #{contextMessageCount} ) ON CONFLICT (run_key) DO UPDATE SET input_tokens = EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens = EXCLUDED.output_tokens, total_tokens = EXCLUDED.total_tokens, model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, compressed_context_tokens = EXCLUDED.compressed_context_tokens, context_message_count = EXCLUDED.context_message_count
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.run_id, e.event_type, e.payload::text AS payload FROM agent_run_events e JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id = e.run_id WHERE r.run_key = #{runKey} AND e.id > COALESCE(#{afterId}, 0) ORDER BY e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_attachments(workspace_id, project_id, uploaded_by, file_name, kind, mime_type, file_size, storage_key, content) VALUES(#{workspaceId}, #{projectId}, #{uploadedBy}, #{fileName}, #{kind}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{storageKey}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.workspace_id, a.project_id, a.uploaded_by, a.file_name, a.kind, a.mime_type, a.file_size, a.storage_key, a.content FROM agent_attachments a JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT a.id, a.workspace_id, a.project_id, a.uploaded_by, a.file_name, a.kind, a.mime_type, a.file_size, a.storage_key, a.content FROM agent_attachments a JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE a.storage_key = #{storageKey} AND a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.project_id = #{projectId} LIMIT 1
